name: New Payment
purpose: 'New Payment' button: refuses (dialog) to add a payment to an invoice that has no customer, otherwise opens the payment card for the invoice with customerId, invoiceId and balance via 'New Payment API' (612).
open_question: The rule 'a payment needs an invoice with a customer' is only enforced in the client here; the target must enforce it in the create-payment operation.

name: Block Payment Commit
purpose: Commit-blocker trigger: lets a commit through only when $$allow_commit is set (then clears it and returns 1), otherwise returns 0 so the commit is cancelled.
open_question: Pairs with 'Save Payment' (704) that sets $$allow_commit before committing; manual commits of the payment card are therefore blocked.

name: Cancel Payment
purpose: Cancels the payment card: reverts the current record without a dialog and closes the window.
writes: Payment record (Revert Record/Request step 2, current record)

name: Choose Open Invoice
purpose: Selecting an open invoice in the popover fills the last payment line: invoice id, customer id of the payment and amount = the invoice balance.
writes:
Payment_PaymentLine::id_Invoice#7 (Set Field step 10, portal row)
Payment_PaymentLine::id_Customer#15 (Set Field step 11, portal row)
Payment_PaymentLine::amount#4 (Set Field step 12, portal row)
open_question: Row scope: portal 'PaymentLines' last row (step 8-9) which may be a new related record (Payment_PaymentLine). Default amount = full balance is a business default.

name: Go To Payment
purpose: Installs a 0.5 s timer to close the popover and opens the invoice's related payment in a new card window on layout 'New Payment Card'.

name: Close Popover After
purpose: OnTimer helper: stops the timer and closes the popover.

name: New Payment API
purpose: Opens the 'Payments' card window on layout 'New Payment Card', creates a new Payment and defaults amount to the invoice balance and date to today, sets the customer, and creates the first payment line for the invoice with the same amount; places the cursor in the payment method field.
writes:
Payment::amount#4 (Set Field step 26, new record)
Payment::date#3 (Set Field step 27, new record)
Payment::id_Customer#2 (Set Field step 30, new record)
Payment_PaymentLine::id_Invoice#7 (Set Field step 31, related via Payment_PaymentLine (new line))
Payment_PaymentLine::amount#4 (Set Field step 32, related via Payment_PaymentLine (new line))
open_question: Step 14 tests $data (never assigned; the variable is $params), so the JSON error exit never fires. New record is created without a commit; commit happens in 'Save Payment' (704).

name: Save Payment
purpose: Save button of the payment card: sets $$allow_commit so the commit blocker lets it through, commits the record without dialog and closes the window.
writes: Payment record (Commit Records/Requests step 4, current record)
